subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should WebChat unresumable restart-recovery failures be represented as persistent delivery-mirror transcript rows, with the branch refreshed against current main before merge?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it defines durable session history behavior and introduces an explicit transcript target path that maintainers should intentionally own before merge.

options.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Notice
options.body: Refresh the branch and land the current fallback if maintainers want WebChat reconnects to show this persistent recovery notice from chat.history.

options.title: Ask For Live WebChat Proof First
options.body: Require a short WebChat restart/reconnect proof before accepting the persistent transcript-row contract.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want restart deferral, immediate user-message persistence, or recover-and-confirm UX to define the durable behavior first.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Notice
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and land the current fallback if maintainers want WebChat reconnects to show this persistent recovery notice from chat.history.
